INSTRUCTIONS:  Use this form when a single information collection document involves multiple reporting and recordkeeping requirements.  The totals of the figures in cols. should be entered in item 13 of OMB-83-I:                  cols. (D) &/or (I) = 13a (respondent is only counted once); cols. F & I = 13b;         cols. H & K = 13c.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       (F)Total/(D)Total = (E)Average     (H)Total/(F)Total = (G)Average     (K)Total/(I)Total = (J)Average
NOTE:  The columns will calculate automatically.  If Col. E's response is something other than annually, i.e., 1/6 years, list as "1/6" & decimal will display.
